lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling, this is the practice's digital assistant, just to let you know, this call's recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, I'm calling about my appointment last Tuesday. I'm really not happy with how it went, and I want to speak to someone in charge, not book anything.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. That's definitely something I'll pass straight to the practice manager rather than try to sort out myself. Can I take your name and a number, so they can call you back today?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's Michael Doyle. And my number's o-seven-nine-nine, double-one-two, three-four-five.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks, Michael. I've flagged this as a priority complaint, the practice manager will call you back before the end of the day. Is there anything urgent I should note for them right now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Just that I want a proper explanation, that's all.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Understood, I've noted that. Someone will be in touch very soon. Thanks for your patience, Michael.
